historical_script_copies: Every attempt executed the exact executed-script.py copied before its Blender launch. All frozen script start/end hashes are in its process receipt.

runner_provenance.attempts_01_02: Runner did not freeze itself or include its hash. No claim of contemporaneous runner artifact. Its command, fixed CPU/time bound and process result are recorded.
runner_provenance.attempt_03: retrospective-runner-source-copy.py was copied from the unchanged source runner after launch, before that runner source was revised. This was added retrospectively and is not an at-launch artifact or contemporaneously recorded runner hash. It was originally named executed-runner.py and has been renamed to avoid that implication.
runner_provenance.attempts_04_05: executed-runner.py was copied by each runner before Blender launch and its SHA is in the final process record.
runner_provenance.portable_current: Current root run-bounded.py was revised after attempt05 to accept explicit paths and reject missing native reports. Only syntax/help checked; not the runner used for attempt05.

native_receipt_integrity: No native report, process.json, FAILURE.json or native.log has been edited after its producer wrote it. process.json intentionally transitions from IN_PROGRESS to terminal while running; those production writes can change its size. Packaging reads native bytes and verifies lossless restore.
superseded_attempt_04: Successful process, scientifically superseded numerical interpretation. It is not relabeled by rewriting native files.
